title: Install door and metadata doors keep two copies of the stored-expression fill notice composer; export one from metadata-protocol
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaysxGzF62ACvZ1x9x

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding (class b, named producer): os-dev round of #35390 (PR #35514, report 7010586784, open question 1). ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: `domain:server` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-expression-fill.ts`, `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`). Suggested-grade: p3 · refactor, no behaviour change. Parent: #35390. Land after PR #35514.
Dedupe: `fillStoredExpressionChange export install door` in open issues: none.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：无（内部整理）。
- 为什么做：升级补算和元数据保存补算现在各有一份提示文字的生成代码，日后容易改了一处忘了另一处。
- 出错会怎样：只是提示文字；改错时两处提示可能不一致。
- 要你做什么：无（分诊定级）。

## What happens

PR #35514 makes the install-local door fill stored computed fields and report `stored-expression-filled` / `stored-expression-fill-incomplete` advisories. The #32527 notice composer (`fillStoredExpressionChange`) and its rule-id constants are not exported from `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, so the door carries a mirrored composer (~80 lines) with the same rule ids and element shape.

## Expected

Export the composer and rule ids from `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (wording parameterised: "this change" vs "this install"), have the install door call it, delete the mirror; the door's fill pins stay green.
